name: Hi-Green Carbon Ltd.
summary: Hi-Green Carbon Ltd. operates in the field of waste tire reprocessing. Its primary function involves transforming discarded tires into usable products, specifically generating hydrocarbon fuel, reclaimed carbon black, and metal scrap. The company was established on August 29, 2011, by its founders Amitkumar Hasmukhrai Bhalodi, Dakshaben Shaileshbhai Makadia, Binaben Sandip Makadia, and Rajendra Umedlal Mehta, and its main office is situated in Rajkot, India.
